title: Validate Sol native tools on editing and implementation tasks
hypothesis: The native tool adapter preserves LCA's tagged-edit safety and improves complete implementation trajectories, not only read-only project orientation.
falsified_if: Native Sol cannot complete tagged edits, loses call correlation during multi-step work, skips focused verification, or performs worse than XML on the existing-codebase or authentication scenarios.
deterministic_outcomes: successful call-id continuation across multiple tool turns
decision_rule: Enable native tools for interactive Sol sessions only if native completes both pilot scenarios without protocol errors, then confirm with three randomized runs per cell. Require native to match or exceed XML pass rate while preserving edit safety and bounded tool use.
